spreads.title: The Cold Hearth and the Pocket Doll

game.start: Help get ready! Match the brass lantern to Vasilissa, bread crust to Kukolka, and warm shawl to Papa Ivan.
game.praise: All ready for winter! Brass lantern, rye bread crust, and warm woollen shawl sit ready for each friend!

game.start: Light the dusky birch trail with Kukolka! Tap all four wooden trail-lanterns to wake their amber glow.
game.praise: Warm amber glow! All four wooden trail-lanterns shine beside the wiggling rowan bush!

game.start: Cross the icy woodland brook with Vasilissa! Tap the three mossy stones in order from left to right.
game.praise: Hop, hop, hop! Vasilissa leaps safely across all three mossy brook-stones!

game.start: Wake Kukolka's golden turning magic! Tap tiny Kukolka three times when the ring turns green.
game.praise: Three bright golden sparks! Tiny Kukolka shines with warm golden magic upon the mossy stump!

game.start: First chore! Match golden wheat to the sack, dark poppy seeds to the bowl, and pebbles to the bucket.
game.praise: Every grain sorted! Woven sack, painted bowl, and wooden bucket stand neat and full!

game.start: Sweep the snowy yard with Vasilissa! Tap all four messy snow-heaps to brush the mossy yard clean.
game.praise: Clean and tidy! Every messy snow-heap vanishes from the mossy forest yard!

game.start: Wake the stove! Match logs to the firebox, pine cones to the grate, and berries to the samovar.
game.praise: All set to kindle! Dry birch logs, pine cones, and sweet berries fill the stove and samovar!

game.start: Light Vasilissa's brass lantern with Baba Yaga's sun-ember! Tap three times when the ring glows green.
game.praise: Three golden bursts! Vasilissa's brass lantern shines like a warm little sun!

game.start: Share the lantern's warm golden light! Tap all four frost-stars along the silver-birch branches to wake them.
game.praise: Twinkle and shine! Four golden frost-stars light the snowy path right toward home!

game.start: Share the feast! Match cakes to the platter, the teapot to the cup, and pine nuts to the bowl.
game.praise: Warmth for all! Honey cakes, hot berry tea, and laughter fill the cosy Russian cottage!
